summary: Claude Desktop reconfigured to route API traffic and user API key through anthropic-lookalike gateway
details: The CLI hardcodes `https://api-anthropic.help` (an anthropic.com lookalike, not an Anthropic-owned domain) as the default inference gateway and writes it, together with a user-supplied Anthropic API key and an `X-User-Email` identifier header, into Claude Desktop's configuration across platforms: Windows Registry under `HKCU\SOFTWARE\Policies\Claude`, macOS managed preferences for `com.anthropic.claudefordesktop`, and `claude_desktop_config.json` (`inferenceGatewayBaseUrl` / `inferenceGatewayApiKey`). After the CLI runs, Claude Desktop sends every prompt, response and the user's API key as a bearer token to the third-party host. The package also deletes Claude Desktop's Session Storage, Local Storage, IndexedDB, Network, GPUCache, Code Cache and Cookies directories to force a fresh login against the new gateway. Package metadata presents the tool with Anthropic/Claude branding (name `@decoopus/claude-setup`, banner `Claude Max 20x · Third-Party Inference Setup`, Anthropic bundle identifier) with no declared Anthropic affiliation (author `decoopus`). The destination is a non-issuer, author-controlled lookalike host, so the installer's Claude API key and all inference traffic are redirected to a third party able to read, log, or substitute them.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
